title: Include next action message in choose_action response when next_action_pending=true
description:
When `choose_action` returns with `next_action_pending=true`, the response includes `next_action_type` and `next_action_hint` but NOT the next action's message text. This forces models to guess what a pending `GAME_ASK` is about if they skip `get_action_choices`.

Evidence from game_20260228_133328_g4:
- Kimi25 Valley (kimi-k2.5) cast Strangling Spores targeting Benalish Honor Guard (which had ward {2})
- After confirming priority, `choose_action(answer=true)` returned `next_action_type: "GAME_ASK"` with the generic hint
- The model skipped `get_action_choices` and guessed the GAME_ASK was asking the opponent about ward payment
- It answered `false` ("don't pay"), thinking this meant the opponent wouldn't pay. In reality, it was being asked whether IT wanted to pay {2} to overcome ward.
- Strangling Spores was countered. The model then celebrated "the Honor Guard is DEAD!" — not realizing its spell fizzled.
- This was the game-losing play.

The `message` text IS available in `buildChoicesResult()` (BridgeCallbackHandler.java:720), so it would be easy to include in the `choose_action` response.

Suggested fix: At BridgeCallbackHandler.java:2032-2034 and :2404-2406, add:
```java
result.put("next_action_message", stripHtml(next.message()));
```

This way models that skip `get_action_choices` still see what the question is about.
